name: Presto Voice (Presto)
oneLiner: Drive-thru voice AI that takes quick-service orders through the existing headset and POS; now run by privately held Presto Phoenix after Presto Automation's assets were sold in late 2024.
bestFor: Multi-unit QSR chains and franchise groups with high-volume drive-thrus that want to automate order-taking.

updates.text: Partnered with ElevenLabs to use its more lifelike text-to-speech voices in Presto Voice at the drive-thru.
Raised $10 million (led by Metropolitan Partners Group) to scale enterprise QSR deployments, saying the product had moved past pilots to hundreds of drive-thru lanes.
Joined the Toast Partner Ecosystem so Toast POS restaurants can send voice-taken drive-thru orders straight to the kitchen.

features: AI voice ordering at the drive-thru speaker post
Runs on the restaurant's existing headsets and POS, with a Toast integration
Lifelike synthetic voices (ElevenLabs), including custom brand voices
notes: Lead confirmed and clarified: Presto Automation (Nasdaq: PRST) was delisted, defaulted on its Metropolitan Partners loan in September 2024, and its assets were sold in December 2024 to a group led by Remus Capital (with Link Ventures and Metropolitan); the business now operates as Presto Phoenix with $18M of new capital, and existing customers carried over. Presto Voice is still sold as of 2026 (funding news in January 2026). A second '$10M' Business Wire item is dated September 2026 and may be a separate round or the same one re-reported; unresolved. Toast integration date not confirmed (listed as 2026 from the funding release mentioning it as recent). The OpenAI/ChatGPT collaboration is from March 2023 (pre-sale) so it is not listed as an update. Dropped from current review: Wienerschnitzel, Captain D's and Fazoli's as customers (not confirmed in current sources; some date from the public-company era) and 'Voice AI market leader' (vendor claim). Vendor's '95% of orders without staff intervention' claim is old and unverified; do not use.
